data_type_and_unit: Survey surface reference and elevations in m
destination: Upstream terrain/formation survey; no R1/R2 object
validation: Confirm datum, coordinate reference system, model transform, units, revision and coverage of work zones
missing_value_handling: Block excavation and backfill quantities within uncovered scope
provenance: Dated survey surface and surveyor verification tied to model revision
required_review_or_approval: Survey/design sign-off; applicable AP-W-EXC-* and AP-W-BACKFILL; AP-TOL for quantity validation
editable_role: PM can attach draft survey; surveyor verifies
downstream_consumer: Future earthworks quantity takeoff for excavation/backfill

data_type_and_unit: Decimal elevation in m per scope
destination: Upstream formation/design level; no R1/R2 object
validation: Check common datum with UI01, footprint coverage, and foundation/blinding interface against section drawings
missing_value_handling: Block affected excavation quantity
provenance: Revisioned formation plans and sections, datum, scope and designer attribution
required_review_or_approval: Design confirmation; applicable AP-W-EXC-* and AP-DR01/02
editable_role: PM can record draft; designer/surveyor confirms
downstream_consumer: Future excavation depth/volume and same-zone dependencies

data_type_and_unit: Enum per zone/depth band
destination: Upstream geotechnical classification; no R1/R2 object
validation: Use supported BCCA classes, confirm depth bands and mapped zone; require explicit mapping from report terminology
missing_value_handling: Block corresponding excavation item selection
provenance: Signed geotechnical report, investigation reference and mapped stratum
required_review_or_approval: Geotechnical sign-off; applicable AP-W-EXC-*
editable_role: Engineer authors; PM can attach report
downstream_consumer: Future earthworks BCCA selection and estimation

data_type_and_unit: Nonnegative distance in m and method enum with design details
destination: Upstream site workspace/shoring spec; any separately defined equipment uses Resource
validation: Validate offsets, scope, slope units and geometry or shoring design, and compatibility with site/ground conditions
missing_value_handling: Block affected excavation scope or volume
provenance: Approved method statement or temporary-works drawings with revision
required_review_or_approval: Construction/geotechnical and temporary-works review; applicable AP-W-EXC-*
editable_role: PM can draft logistics; engineer confirms method and dimensions
downstream_consumer: Future excavation quantity and work method estimation

data_type_and_unit: Nullable boolean and thickness in m when specified
destination: Upstream blinding design spec; accepted derived activity can map to NormalizedActivity in future
validation: Require explicit yes/no and matching design; positive thickness when specified; enforce applicable catalogue basis after item selection
missing_value_handling: Unknown blocks affected blinding or foundation sequence; explicit no omits blinding only within confirmed scope
provenance: Revisioned foundation drawing and specification matching the zone
required_review_or_approval: AP-W-BLD and AP-DR02 where applicable; designer confirms
editable_role: PM can transcribe design; engineer confirms
downstream_consumer: Future BLD takeoff and foundation precedence

user_facing_label: Construction method per element group (cast-in-place / precast / composite)
data_type_and_unit: Enum per model-scoped group
destination: construction_method.per_element_group[] upstream classification
validation: Validate applicable category, model/group identities, conflicting assignments and composite-versus-separate-item coverage
missing_value_handling: Unknown method blocks affected work-package routing
provenance: Revisioned designer specification, method statement and group/GlobalId list
required_review_or_approval: AP-CR06; AP-CR05 or AP-CR04 and AP-DC04 where applicable
editable_role: PM can propose group assignment; engineer/BIM coordinator reviews classification
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.2 classification and Stage 5.3 route/item selection

user_facing_label: Foundation confirmation for candidate IfcBeam/IfcSlab elements
data_type_and_unit: Nullable boolean per candidate element
destination: Upstream Stage 5.2 foundation classification
validation: Require model-version GlobalId and traceable design role; verify subtype where needed and exclude confirmed foundations from beam routing
missing_value_handling: Leave candidate unresolved and block affected classification/work items
provenance: Foundation plans, schedule/section reference and full GlobalId
required_review_or_approval: AP-CR11, AP-DC11; AP-CR12 where footing subtype applies; applicable AP-W-FND-*
editable_role: PM can flag candidates; structural/BIM review resolves them
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.2 classification and future foundation takeoff/work generation

data_type_and_unit: Pair of controlled enums per scope
destination: concrete_specification upstream; SupplySource.product for declared supply
validation: Check class/consistency against design and selected catalogue variant; validate supply product compatibility; unsupported variants block
missing_value_handling: Block corresponding concrete item and any dependent supply plan
provenance: Revisioned structural spec/mix designation and compatible supplier product declaration
required_review_or_approval: Applicable AP-W-*-CONC; AP-X-SUP-01 for supply
editable_role: PM can record supplier declaration; structural engineer confirms specification
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 BCCA estimation; future CP-SAT concrete supply

user_facing_label: Reinforcement mass per element or bar schedule
data_type_and_unit: Decimal kg per element or revisioned BOQ allocation
destination: reinforcement_mass_kg[] upstream engineering quantity
validation: Require source mass and allocation linked to GlobalIds; check steel grade, bar/mesh and totals; prevent double allocation; no generic kg/m3 factors
missing_value_handling: Block affected rebar estimate; unknown mass stays null
provenance: Designer bar schedule, rebar model or design quantity with document revision and allocation basis
required_review_or_approval: AP-DC05 and applicable AP-W-*-REBAR
editable_role: PM can attach or transcribe a designer source; structural engineer confirms mass and allocation
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 rebar demand, duration and cost estimation

data_type_and_unit: System enum and face rules; contact m2; separate integer asset counts in declared units
destination: formwork upstream; Resource.capacity, Reservation.quantity and ReleaseCondition for declared asset plans, including separately scoped reshoring reservations
validation: Validate faces, junction deductions, contact area and matching asset pool/unit/demand; confirm release, return and reshoring separately
missing_value_handling: Block formwork estimation without contact basis; separately block undeclared reservation constraints for affected use
provenance: Signed face rules/measurements and site inventory plus approved reservation and release plan
required_review_or_approval: Applicable AP-W-*-FORM, AP-DC02/06/07, AP-CR13; AP-X-FW-01 to 04 for reusable assets
editable_role: PM/site may supply inventory; construction engineer and QS review method and measured basis
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 formwork takeoff and estimate; CP-SAT reservations

data_type_and_unit: Nullable boolean per formed-face scope
destination: formwork.finish upstream item selection
validation: Check face scope and finish specification; split mixed finishes and verify compatible catalogue variant
missing_value_handling: Block unresolved formwork variant where finish determines item
provenance: Architectural finish schedule/drawing with revision and face references
required_review_or_approval: Applicable AP-W-*-FORM variant; owning design review for finish
editable_role: PM transcribes; architect/construction reviewer confirms
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 visto/revestir variant, cost and productivity

user_facing_label: Curing method and duration / strength criterion
data_type_and_unit: Method and time/strength/both enum with days or elapsed minutes and MPa as applicable
destination: curing upstream; StrengthReleaseEvent where it controls a release
validation: Require parameters for selected criterion, time basis and linked pour; distinguish predicted criterion from evidenced strength result
missing_value_handling: Block affected curing/release assumptions; no default duration or fabricated test
provenance: Signed curing plan and criterion; timestamped verified test record where claimed
required_review_or_approval: AP-W-CURE, AP-DR07, AP-DC03; AP-X-STR-01/02 for applicable strength events
editable_role: Engineer defines basis; PM records referenced documents
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 elapsed hold; CPM/CP-SAT elapsed or strength gates

data_type_and_unit: Per-component criterion enum with elapsed days or MPa and release linkage
destination: striking upstream; ReleaseCondition and StrengthReleaseEvent; Reservation release for applicable assets
validation: Distinguish sides, soffits and props; validate controlling pour/test, support order, reuse delay and retained/reshored assets
missing_value_handling: Block affected stripping, release or reuse; no automatic release
provenance: Approved temporary-works/striking plan and authenticated test/release record where applicable
required_review_or_approval: AP-DR08, AP-W-FRM-STRIP, AP-X-FW-03/04, AP-X-STR-01/02, AP-X-SEQ-01 where applicable
editable_role: Construction/temporary-works engineer defines criteria; PM can record proposed release plan
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 stripping duration/input; CPM sequence and CP-SAT release/reservations

user_facing_label: Crew composition per trade and daily working hours
data_type_and_unit: Integer persons by trade; time windows and hours per day
destination: crews[] upstream; CrewMode.units, Resource.capacity, ResourceCalendar; conditional equipment uses Resource
validation: Validate trade IDs, nonnegative units, positive demand coverage and calendar consistency; distinguish mode staffing from pooled availability; require evidence for fixed modes
missing_value_handling: Block affected crew estimates/feasibility when required; explicit none only where supported and declared
provenance: Contractor roster and trade assignment, resource commitments and shift plan
required_review_or_approval: Owning staffing decision; AP-X-CREW-01 for fixed modes; AP-X-CAL-01 for applicable exceptions; AP-DR11 for zone progression
editable_role: PM/contractor can draft operational values; qualified reviewer confirms exceptions and staffing basis
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 trade-based duration and CP-SAT renewable capacities/modes

data_type_and_unit: IANA timezone, local weekly HH:mm windows, dated exceptions and ISO start/horizon
destination: calendar upstream; ResourceCalendar, CalendarException and NormalizedProblem.project_start
validation: Check timezone and local dates, non-overlapping windows, project and resource calendars, exceptions and nonnegative dated capacity when used
missing_value_handling: Block date scheduling where calendar/project start is required; avoid implicit holiday/shift values
provenance: Published jurisdiction calendar and revisioned site/contractor working programme with owner
required_review_or_approval: AP-X-CAL-01 and AP-X-CAL-02 where applicable; PM confirms base plan and official source
editable_role: PM can draft administrative data and base shifts; calendar exceptions reviewed
downstream_consumer: CPM calendars; CP-SAT preparation and local-date capacity

data_type_and_unit: Unique zone IDs and model-scoped GlobalId membership
destination: zones[] upstream Stage 5.2 package assignment; no dedicated scheduler zone object
validation: Check model/revision, membership resolution, duplicate or conflicting assignments and applicability; adjacency creates no dependencies
missing_value_handling: Block zone-dependent sequencing/allocation where required; no inferred zoning
provenance: Revisioned logistics/zone drawing and model-scoped membership list
required_review_or_approval: AP-DR11 for zone progression; AP-DR15 constrains dependency generation
editable_role: PM/planner drafts; BIM/site reviewer confirms membership and qualified reviewer approves sequence rules
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.2 grouping and future zone-based crew planning

data_type_and_unit: Duration in days entered with explicit conversion to minutes; criterion and dated pass event
destination: sequence_choice.inspection_hold_hours_before_pour upstream; InspectorRequirement and InspectionPassEvent
validation: Check inspection position, resource/calendar, criterion, scope and event authority; separate planned duration from actual recorded pass
missing_value_handling: Block dependent pour/backfill or report only an authorized conditional scope; never assume pass or default zero
provenance: Inspection/test plan, authority and timestamped scoped result when actual pass is asserted
required_review_or_approval: AP-X-INSP-01; AP-DR04/06/12 as applicable
editable_role: PM may enter logistics; site engineer/inspector defines criterion and records actual pass
downstream_consumer: CPM hold and dependency setup; CP-SAT inspection and release gating

data_type_and_unit: Positive dimensionless ratios for explicitly named source/target volume bases
destination: Upstream earthworks quantity conversion; no direct scheduler object
validation: Validate conversion direction, applicable soil/method, units and basis for each factor; prevent double conversion
missing_value_handling: Block dependent backfill volume and rate estimates
provenance: Revisioned geotechnical test/spec and approved conversion basis
required_review_or_approval: AP-DC12, AP-W-BACKFILL
editable_role: Geotechnical/earthworks engineer supplies; PM may attach source
downstream_consumer: Future backfill conversion, quantities and estimation

data_type_and_unit: Supplier text/ID, unit type, and logistics record with equipment units/calendar
destination: Upstream supplier/unit/lift plan; equipment[] to Resource and applicable activity demand
validation: Verify approved unit scope and availability, lift suitability, equipment units/calendar and work item coverage
missing_value_handling: Block unsupported precast estimate and undeclared lift/equipment constraints; no BCCA fallback
provenance: Approved supplier submittal and lift plan plus contractor equipment availability
required_review_or_approval: AP-CR04, AP-W-SLAB-PRECAST, AP-DR14 and applicable lift approval
editable_role: PM/site may enter supplier and availability; structural/lifting specialist confirms system and plan
downstream_consumer: Future Stage 5.3 precast estimation and scheduling equipment/precedence

data_type_and_unit: Material enum plus positive dimensional thickness in m or mm normalized to m
destination: Upstream masonry item/material specification; no direct scheduler object
validation: Check material category and thickness against design and catalogue; confirm net-area/opening basis if applicable
missing_value_handling: Block unsupported masonry item or dependent estimate
provenance: Revisioned wall type schedule and unit specification scoped to elements
required_review_or_approval: AP-CR02/03/09 and AP-W-MAS-* by material; AP-DC14 and AP-DR13 where applicable
editable_role: PM can transcribe; design/QS review confirms item and quantity basis
downstream_consumer: Future masonry classification, BCCA estimation and support sequencing

data_type_and_unit: Nullable boolean per slab identified by model and GlobalId
destination: formwork.slab_on_grade_global_ids upstream; explicit draft decision needed per slab
validation: Check slab support against details; distinguish explicit suspended/ground-bearing from unknown; review mixed scope
missing_value_handling: Block slab-formwork determination for unresolved slabs
provenance: Revisioned slab sections and bearing details plus GlobalId
required_review_or_approval: AP-CR13 and applicable AP-W-SLAB-FORM
editable_role: PM may flag candidates; structural reviewer confirms
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.2 classification and Stage 5.3 slab-formwork scope

user_facing_label: Column height measurement rule at joints (clear / through)
data_type_and_unit: Enum plus scope, interface rules and derived height in m
destination: measurement_rules.column_height upstream
validation: Require consistent joint boundaries and overlap treatment; reconcile slab/beam interfaces to prevent double count
missing_value_handling: Block affected column quantity or estimate
provenance: Signed measurement rule and joint details with model revision; trace measured height
required_review_or_approval: AP-DC07 and applicable AP-W-COL-CONC/FORM; AP-TOL for quantity validation
editable_role: QS/structural reviewer defines basis; PM may attach evidence
downstream_consumer: Stage 5.3 column concrete/formwork quantity and estimation
